annotations.title: Read any public page as clean Markdown, with hidden text removed

description:
Returns a public https page as clean Markdown for an agent (headings, lists, tables kept; navigation, cookie banners, scripts and everything hidden from people removed), strips invisible Unicode and flags text aimed at the model — with verdict, score, findings, title and language. JSON and text pass through. One GET as a declared bot, no login or bot-protection bypass; a blocked page is never charged. Free with a key (500 calls) or 5 calls a day without one; then 0.02 USDC per call via x402, or 1 call from a key.
After: preflight before your agent buys or pays anything the page offers (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Your key instead of paying per call: free (500 calls, POST /key) or bought by card. The connection header X-Bundle-Token works too.

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from (optional; the x402 price is the same for every address).

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

url.description: the public https page to read (1 MB, 10 s)
